articles.title: Proposed billionaires' tax in California rattles Silicon Valley, entangles Gov. Newsom
articles.mainIdea: Proposed billionaires' tax in California rattles Silicon Valley, entangles Gov. Newsom
articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Proposed billionaires' tax in California rattles Silicon Valley, entangles Gov. Newsom. A proposed billionaires' tax in California has ignited a political uproar in Silicon Valley, with tech titans threatening to leave the state while Democratic Gov. Gavin Newsom maneuvers to defeat a levy that he fears will lead to an exodus of wealth. A technology mecca, California has more billionaires than any other state — a few hundred, by some estimates. Nearly half its personal income tax revenue, a financial backbone in the nearly $350 billion budget, comes from the top 1% of earners. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, TSLA.

articles.title: Meet Caria Raises $1M Pre-Seed Round at $3M Valuation Led by ANF Investment
articles.mainIdea: Meet Caria Raises $1M Pre-Seed Round at $3M Valuation Led by ANF Investment
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Meet Caria Raises $1M Pre-Seed Round at $3M Valuation Led by ANF Investment. Image by Meet Caria LLC NEW YORK, Jan. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Meet Caria, an AI-native recruitment software company, announced that it has raised $1 million in a pre-seed funding round at a $3 million valuation, led by ANF Investment, a Dubai-based investment firm led by CEO Ali Al Shamsi. The funding will be used to further develop Caria, Meet Caria’s AI-based recruitment platform, which supports hiring workflows including job creation, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and candidate eval Related tickers mentioned: CAPMF.
